verdict.rationale: Azure is a cloud platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official Microsoft MCP server documented at github.com/microsoft/mcp, but that single mention is the only evidence. missing for 10: details on which Azure services and tools the server exposes, setup and auth docs (e.g. Entra/managed identity integration), transport or hosted-endpoint options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
